_comment: (Theme B2 · AC-5) committed diarization-accuracy thresholds — the SIBLING of streaming_thresholds.json (owned, left untouched). Every 'baseline' is null until a LIVE capture of the diarizer (embedding clustering) on real de-identified 2-speaker clinical audio lands; an ABSOLUTE bootstrap ceiling/floor gates in the meantime. Tighten each 'baseline' to the captured in-domain value (keeping the documented epsilon) once the live scorecard lands. Published CALLHOME 2-spk DER (~0.099 pyannote) is NOT clinical and NOT collar-free — do not adopt it as the number; these bootstraps only catch a badly-broken diarizer.

der._note: Lower is better; PRIMARY diarization gate. ceiling 0.40 is a conservative collar-free bootstrap for 2-speaker clinical audio (leaves headroom over clean-audio DER yet still catches a broken diarizer). epsilon 0.05 = allowed drift once the in-domain baseline is captured.

jaccard_error_rate._note: Lower is better; per-reference-speaker Jaccard error (over-penalizes the minority speaker vs DER). ceiling 0.50 bootstrap.

speaker_confusion_rate._note: Lower is better; the headline 2-speaker error — clinician↔patient swap time / reference speech. ceiling 0.15 bootstrap; this is the metric most tied to the user-visible label being wrong.

attribution_accuracy._note: Higher is better; fraction of reference speech attributed to the correctly-mapped speaker. floor 0.85 bootstrap; tighten to baseline-epsilon once captured.
